title: Follow Button
content: Build follow/unfollow button component. States: not following ("Follow" blue/primary), following ("Following" gray outline), hover on following ("Unfollow" red). Animation: smooth transition between states. Loading state: spinner while processing. Optimistic update: change immediately, revert on error. Count display: optional follower count. Mutual follow: show "Follows you" badge. Sizes: sm, md, lg.

variants.simple: Create follow/unfollow button with state changes and loading state.
variants.detailed: Build follow/unfollow button component. States: not following ("Follow" blue/primary), following ("Following" gray outline), hover on following ("Unfollow" red). Animation: smooth transition between states. Loading state: spinner while processing. Optimistic update: change immediately, revert on error. Count display: optional follower count. Mutual follow: show "Follows you" badge. Sizes: sm, md, lg.
variants.advanced: Build follow/unfollow button component with comprehensive state handling. States: not following (bg-black text-white "Follow"), following (bg-transparent border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 "Following"), hover on following state (border-red-300 text-red-600 "Unfollow"). Animation: smooth transition-all duration-200 between states, subtle scale on click. Loading state: spinner (Loader2 animate-spin) replacing text while processing API call, button disabled. Optimistic update: change UI state immediately on click for snappy feel, revert if API call fails with error toast. Click handler: toggle follow state, API POST /follow or DELETE /unfollow, update follower count in UI (+1 or -1). Count display: optional inline follower count badge next to button or separate. Mutual follow indicator: "Follows you" badge (text-xs text-gray-500) shown near button or on profile. Private account: show "Request" instead of "Follow", pending state shows "Requested" (can cancel), approved converts to "Following". Variants: icon only (UserPlus/UserMinus icons for compact spaces like user lists), text only, text + icon, full button. Sizes: sm (text-xs px-3 py-1), md (text-sm px-4 py-1.5), lg (px-6 py-2). Mobile: ensure min 44x44px touch target. Confirmation: optional confirm dialog for unfollow ("Stop following @username?") to prevent accidental unfollows. Block state: if user is blocked, show "Blocked" in disabled button state, or hide follow button entirely. Keyboard: Enter/Space triggers action. Accessibility: clear aria-label describing current state and action ("Follow @username" or "Unfollow @username"), aria-pressed for toggle state, announce state changes to screen readers. Error handling: show toast on failure, button reverts to previous state.
